data.one_liner: Stream LLM responses into Flutter as live markdown with typewriter animations and markdown support.
data.what_it_does: Takes a Stream of text chunks from an LLM and renders them smoothly as markdown with built-in typewriter or fade animations, LaTeX support, and RTL text handling. It also provides programmatic controls like pause, resume, and skip.
use_when: You need to render incoming token streams from LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini as live markdown.
You want typewriter or fade reveal animations for streamed text without breaking markdown syntax.
avoid_when: You only need to display static markdown that never streams.
You are building a complete chat UI with bubbles, composer, and scroll management (use a chat UI package instead).
strengths: Optimized specifically for LLM text streaming with smooth pacing and animations.
Tolerates half-finished markdown syntax without flashing raw markers.
Includes presets for popular AI models like ChatGPT and Claude.
weaknesses: Depends on specific third-party markdown and math rendering packages.
Animation and styling require configuring custom themes or passing specific parameters.
